SELECT statut, SUM(nb_mandats) AS nb_mandats FROM analytics.mart_mandat_performance GROUP BY statut ORDER BY nb_mandats DESC;

SELECT CASE WHEN est_exclusif THEN 'Exclusive' ELSE 'Non-exclusive' END AS exclusivity, SUM(nb_mandats) AS nb_mandats FROM analytics.mart_mandat_performance GROUP BY est_exclusif ORDER BY nb_mandats DESC;
SELECT source_nom, nb_annonces FROM analytics.mart_market_by_source ORDER BY nb_annonces DESC;
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(derniere_collecte)) * 1000 AS last_collection FROM analytics.mart_market_by_source;
